words.defn_en: occurring or operating at the same time:

sentences.en: The rise in sales was ______ with the launch of the new ad campaign.
sentences.zh: 銷售量的上升與新廣告宣傳活動的推出恰好同時發生。

sentences.en: Her promotion was merely ______ with the company's restructuring, not caused by it.
sentences.zh: 她的升遷只是恰巧與公司重組同時發生,並非因此而起。

sentences.en: She ______ an old friend at the store.
sentences.zh: 她在商店裡巧遇了一位老朋友。

sentences.en: Climbers may ______ dangerous conditions near the summit.
sentences.zh: 登山者在接近山頂時可能會遇到危險的天候狀況。

sentences.en: Teachers often ______ students to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 老師們常常鼓勵學生提出問題。

sentences.en: Her parents always ______ her to follow her dreams.
sentences.zh: 她的父母總是鼓勵她追求自己的夢想。

sentences.en: Their 50-year friendship is ______.
sentences.zh: 他們五十年的友誼歷久不衰。

sentences.en: The novel has left an ______ mark on modern literature.
sentences.zh: 這部小說在現代文學中留下了持久深遠的影響。

sentences.en: She was so ______ in her book that she didn't hear the phone ring.
sentences.zh: 她全神貫注地看書,以至於沒聽到電話響。

sentences.en: The children remained ______ in the puzzle for over an hour.
sentences.zh: 孩子們全神貫注地玩拼圖,持續了一個多小時。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can ______ both your physical and mental health.
sentences.zh: 規律運動能夠提升你的身心健康。

sentences.en: The new lighting was added to ______ the beauty of the garden at night.
sentences.zh: 增設新的燈光是為了在夜晚增添花園的美感。

words.defn_en: a feeling of discontent aroused by another's possessions or qualities:

sentences.en: She couldn't help feeling ______ toward her successful sister.
sentences.zh: 她忍不住對她成功的姊姊感到嫉妒。

sentences.en: Everyone seemed to ______ his effortless charm.
sentences.zh: 似乎每個人都羨慕他毫不費力的魅力。

sentences.en: The lantern ______ the path through the forest.
sentences.zh: 這盞燈籠照亮了穿越森林的小徑。

sentences.en: Her lecture helped ______ the more confusing parts of the theory.
sentences.zh: 她的講座有助於闡明這項理論中較令人困惑的部分。

words.defn_en: something unreal that gives the appearance of being real

sentences.en: The magician created the ______ of sawing a woman in half.
sentences.zh: 這位魔術師製造出將一名女子鋸成兩半的幻覺效果。

sentences.en: He lived under the ______ that fame would bring him happiness.
sentences.zh: 他一直活在名氣會帶來幸福的幻想之中。

words.root_note: in- (against) + ludere (to play, deceive), from Latin

sentences.en: The sense of security she felt was entirely ______ .
sentences.zh: 她所感受到的安全感完全是虛幻的。

sentences.en: Economists warned that the growth figures were ______ .
sentences.zh: 經濟學家警告這些成長數據其實是虛幻不實的。

words.defn_en: well-known, respected, and admired for achievements:

sentences.en: Her ______ career as a scientist inspired countless students.
sentences.zh: 她身為科學家的卓越生涯激勵了無數學生。

sentences.en: The university welcomed several ______ alumni back for the anniversary celebration.
sentences.zh: 這所大學在週年慶祝活動中歡迎了幾位傑出的校友回校。

sentences.en: Guests were invited to ______ freely at the open bar.
sentences.zh: 賓客們被邀請在這個免費吧台盡情暢飲。

sentences.en: He seemed to ______ every piece of advice his mentor gave him.
sentences.zh: 他似乎將導師給予的每一項建議都全盤吸收了。

sentences.en: She decided to ______ herself in Spanish culture by living with a host family.
sentences.zh: 她決定住在寄宿家庭裡,讓自己完全沉浸在西班牙文化中。

sentences.en: He would ______ himself in his novels for hours, forgetting the world around him.
sentences.zh: 他常常一連好幾個小時沉浸在他的小說中,忘卻周遭的世界。

words.defn_en: a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country:

sentences.en: Many ______ s founded successful businesses in their new country.
sentences.zh: 許多移民在他們的新國家創立了成功的事業。

sentences.en: Her grandparents were ______ s who settled in the city decades ago.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父母是幾十年前定居這座城市的移民。

words.defn_en: to come to live permanently in a foreign country:

sentences.en: They decided to ______ in search of better opportunities.
sentences.zh: 他們決定移民以尋求更好的機會。

sentences.en: It took years for the family to ______ legally.
sentences.zh: 這個家庭花了好幾年才合法移民入境。

sentences.en: The monk chose to ______ himself for a lifetime of prayer.
sentences.zh: 這位僧侶選擇將自己終身禁閉,潛心祈禱。

sentences.en: The prisoner was ______ d in a windowless cell.
sentences.zh: 這名囚犯被禁閉在一間沒有窗戶的牢房裡。

words.defn_en: the act of confining or imprisoning someone:

sentences.en: The historical account describes the queen's ______ in the tower.
sentences.zh: 這份歷史記載描述了這位女王被囚禁在這座塔中。

sentences.en: Years of solitary ______ left him deeply changed.
sentences.zh: 多年的孤獨禁閉讓他徹底改變了。

words.defn_en: a marked effect or influence; to have an effect on:
words.root_note: in- (into) + pangere (to fix, drive), from Latin

sentences.en: The new policy had a significant ______ on small businesses.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策對小型企業產生了重大影響。

sentences.en: Climate change continues to ______ agricultural yields.
sentences.zh: 氣候變遷持續影響著農業產量。

words.defn_en: to weaken or damage the function of something:
words.root_note: in- (into) + pejorare (to make worse), from Latin

sentences.en: Lack of sleep can ______ concentration and memory.
sentences.zh: 缺乏睡眠可能會損害專注力與記憶力。

sentences.en: The accident permanently ______ ed his vision.
sentences.zh: 這場意外永久損害了他的視力。

words.defn_en: to make information known or to give something:

sentences.en: The professor ______ her vast knowledge to the eager students.
sentences.zh: 這位教授將她淵博的知識傳授給求知若渴的學生。

sentences.en: A good mentor knows how to ______ wisdom without lecturing.
sentences.zh: 優秀的導師懂得如何傳授智慧,而不是一味說教。

sentences.en: Her ______ plea moved the entire council to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 她充滿激情的懇求讓整個議會重新考慮。

sentences.en: He delivered an ______ defense of his controversial theory.
sentences.zh: 他慷慨激昂地為自己具爭議性的理論辯護。

sentences.en: Heavy traffic continued to ______ the ambulance's progress.
sentences.zh: 壅塞的車流持續阻礙救護車前進。

sentences.en: Language barriers can ______ effective communication between teams.
sentences.zh: 語言隔閡可能會妨礙團隊之間的有效溝通。

sentences.en: Lack of funding remained the project's biggest ______ .
sentences.zh: 資金不足仍是這項計畫最大的阻礙。

sentences.en: A speech ______ made public speaking difficult for him.
sentences.zh: 一種語言障礙讓他在公開演說上感到困難。

words.defn_en: to drive or force someone to do something:

sentences.en: Curiosity ______ led her to open the mysterious box.
sentences.zh: 好奇心驅使她打開了這個神秘的盒子。

sentences.en: A sense of duty ______ led him to volunteer for the mission.
sentences.zh: 責任感驅使他自願參與這項任務。

sentences.en: They prepared for the ______ storm by boarding up windows.
sentences.zh: 他們為即將來臨的暴風雨釘上木板封窗以做準備。

sentences.en: A sense of ______ doom hung over the entire village.
sentences.zh: 一股大難臨頭的氣氛籠罩著整個村莊。

sentences.en: His ______ decision to quit his job left him without income.
sentences.zh: 他衝動地決定辭職,結果讓自己失去了收入來源。

sentences.en: She regretted her ______ outburst almost as soon as she spoke.
sentences.zh: 她幾乎在說出口的瞬間就對自己衝動的發言感到後悔。

words.defn_en: to impact, affect, make an impression:

sentences.en: The new regulations ______ on the freedom of small business owners.
sentences.zh: 這項新法規侵犯了小企業主的自由。

sentences.en: Loud construction noise began to ______ on the neighborhood's peace.
sentences.zh: 工地的巨大噪音開始影響到這個社區的寧靜。

words.defn_en: to insert or fix into place; a device placed within the body:

sentences.en: Doctors will ______ the device during a short surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫生將在一次短暫的手術中植入這個裝置。

sentences.en: She received a dental ______ after losing a tooth.
sentences.zh: 她掉了一顆牙後接受了牙科植入手術。

words.defn_en: to put a plan or decision into action; to carry out:

sentences.en: The company decided to ______ the new policy starting next month.
sentences.zh: 這家公司決定從下個月起實施這項新政策。

sentences.en: The business will ______ new rules to comply with the change in laws.
sentences.zh: 這家企業將實施新規定,以配合法律的變動。

words.defn_en: to involve in an incriminating way, incriminate:

sentences.en: New evidence began to ______ several company executives in the fraud.
sentences.zh: 新的證據開始牽連數名公司高層涉入這起詐欺案。

sentences.en: He refused to ______ his friends, even under intense questioning.
sentences.zh: 即使受到嚴厲的盤問,他仍拒絕牽連他的朋友。

sentences.en: The policy change has serious ______ for lobbyists.
sentences.zh: 這項政策的改變對遊說團體帶來了嚴重的影響。

sentences.en: She didn't fully consider the ______ of quitting her job so suddenly.
sentences.zh: 她並未充分考慮到突然辭職所帶來的影響。

sentences.en: His approval was ______ in his silence.
sentences.zh: 他的沉默暗示著他的默許。

sentences.en: There was an ______ understanding between them that no one would mention the accident.
sentences.zh: 他們之間有一種心照不宣的默契,誰都不會提起那場意外。

sentences.en: Her tone seemed to ______ disapproval.
sentences.zh: 她的語氣似乎暗示著不贊同。

sentences.en: The data ______ ies a strong correlation between the two factors.
sentences.zh: 這些數據暗示這兩個因素之間存在著強烈的相關性。

words.defn_en: to bring in goods from abroad; significance:

sentences.en: The country began to ______ machinery from overseas.
sentences.zh: 這個國家開始從海外進口機械。

sentences.en: The discovery holds great ______ for future medical research.
sentences.zh: 這項發現對未來的醫學研究具有重大的意義。

words.defn_en: to invoke a curse upon someone:

sentences.en: The old woman was said to ______ misfortune on her enemies.
sentences.zh: 據說這位老婦人會對她的敵人詛咒厄運。

sentences.en: He began to ______ against the fate that had ruined him.
sentences.zh: 他開始咒罵那毀了他的命運。

sentences.en: He muttered a bitter ______ under his breath.
sentences.zh: 他小聲地低聲咒罵了一句。

sentences.en: The play's villain unleashes a terrifying ______ on the hero.
sentences.zh: 這齣戲的反派對主角發出了一句可怕的詛咒。

words.defn_en: a person who curses or invokes evil upon another:

sentences.en: The village feared the old ______ and her supposed powers.
sentences.zh: 村民懼怕這位老詛咒者以及她所謂的能力。

sentences.en: He was branded an ______ after his furious tirade.
sentences.zh: 他在這番憤怒的長篇咒罵後被貼上了咒罵者的標籤。

sentences.en: The psalm's ______ verses call for the downfall of enemies.
sentences.zh: 這首詩篇裡詛咒性的詩句呼求敵人的垮台。

sentences.en: His ______ letter shocked the newspaper's editors.
sentences.zh: 他這封詛咒性的信讓報社編輯感到震驚。

words.defn_en: to fill or saturate with a substance; to make pregnant:

sentences.en: Workers ______ the wood with a protective sealant.
sentences.zh: 工人用一種保護性密封劑浸透這塊木頭。

sentences.en: The fabric was ______ d with a waterproof coating.
sentences.zh: 這種布料被浸透了一層防水塗層。

words.defn_en: filled or saturated with a substance:

sentences.en: The soil was ______ with minerals from centuries of erosion.
sentences.zh: 這片土壤因數個世紀的侵蝕而富含礦物質。

sentences.en: Her clothes were ______ with the scent of woodsmoke.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服上浸滿了木柴煙的氣味。

sentences.en: His ______ decision to quit surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 他衝動辭職的決定讓每個人都感到驚訝。

sentences.en: She regretted the ______ purchase almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 她幾乎立刻就後悔了這次衝動的購物。

words.defn_en: the act of attributing blame or fault to someone:

sentences.en: He strongly denied the ______ of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 他堅決否認了這項不當行為的指控。

sentences.en: The article carried an unfair ______ against the company.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章對這家公司提出了不公平的指控。

sentences.en: Critics ______d the company's failure to poor management decisions.
sentences.zh: 評論家將這家公司的失敗歸咎於糟糕的管理決策。

sentences.en: It would be unfair to ______ malice to what was likely just a mistake.
sentences.zh: 把這很可能只是個失誤歸咎為惡意,是不公平的。

words.defn_en: emitting light as a result of being heated; brilliant:

sentences.en: The old ______ bulb finally burned out after years of use.
sentences.zh: 這顆老舊的白熾燈泡在用了多年後終於燒壞了。

sentences.en: Her ______ performance stunned the entire audience.
sentences.zh: 她光輝燦爛的演出讓全場觀眾為之震撼。

sentences.en: The villagers whispered that the old man was evil ______.
sentences.zh: 村民們竊竊私語,說這位老人是邪惡的化身。

sentences.en: To his students, the professor seemed like wisdom ______.
sentences.zh: 在學生眼中,這位教授彷彿是智慧的化身。

words.defn_en: the start, the beginning of something

sentences.en: The company has grown tremendously since its ______ ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 自從十年前創立以來,這家公司已有了長足的發展。

sentences.en: He has led the project from its ______ to its final launch.
sentences.zh: 他從這項計畫一開始就領導著它,直到最終上線。

sentences.en: The plan was still ______, with many details left to be worked out.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫仍處於未成形的早期階段,還有許多細節有待確定。

sentences.en: His ______ ideas about the novel had not yet taken a clear shape.
sentences.zh: 他對這部小說的構想仍處於早期未成形的階段。

sentences.en: The school reported the ______ to the police immediately.
sentences.zh: 這所學校立刻將這起事件呈報給警方。

sentences.en: No one was hurt in the minor traffic ______.
sentences.zh: 在這起輕微的交通事故中沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: The main plot focused on the war, with romance as an ______ subplot.
sentences.zh: 主要劇情聚焦於戰爭,愛情故事只是附帶的次要情節。

sentences.en: Any ______ expenses during the trip will be reimbursed by the company.
sentences.zh: 這趟旅程中任何附帶的花費,公司都會予以報銷。

sentences.en: Doctors were able to treat the ______ stage of the disease before it spread.
sentences.zh: 醫生得以在疾病擴散之前治療這個初期階段。

sentences.en: The manager noticed ______ signs of conflict between the two employees.
sentences.zh: 經理注意到這兩名員工之間初現的衝突跡象。
